messages:
olivia: quick sync — we need to lock the label contract for routing/quota dashboards. product wants route-level breakdowns, infra needs cardinality guardrails. cc @eng-platform @devex

suresh: short question — do we treat model_variant as a first-class label? worried it explodes when QA/experimental variants come in

aj: prefer keep model + variant but bucket variants into 'stable'/'canary'/'experimental'. add quantization_profile as separate label only if it’s low-card (eg q8/q4/q2). avoid freeform variant IDs

marie: +1 on bucketing. also propose renaming "routing_policy" -> "route_key" so dashboards read nicer (route_key: cost_aware | latency_first | fallback). less verbose in panels

ryan: fyi don't add request_id, trace_id, or user_id as labels (obvious), and watch for sequence_length raw values — use buckets (short/medium/long) or histograms

devex-bot: shared doc: https://redwood.link/telemetry-routing-labels (contains draft mapping and dashboard templates) :eyes:

olivia: proposal: cap unique values per label to ~1000 in Prom; if we expect >1000, move that dimension to logging/trace or aggregate in the agent. use label sanitization: strip tenant prefixes and normalize model names

suresh: question on deployment types — do we want a deployment_tier label (hosted|dedicated|private)? dashboards should be able to split by that without exploding cardinality
aj: yes — deployment_tier is low-card and useful. also add region and env (prod/staging). shard_id is useful for perf debugging but make it optional in panels

marie: suggested metric shape (example):
```
# counter of inference requests routed
redwood_inference_requests_total{env="prod",region="us-east-1",deployment_tier="dedicated",model="gptj-6b",model_variant="stable",route_key="latency_first",status="ok"}
```
Keep label names snake_case, short, and consistent with OTel conventions where possible

ryan: for latency we should emit summary/histogram: redwood_inference_latency_ms_bucket with same label set (minus very high-card labels). add kv_cache_hit as a separate gauge with the same safe label set

metrics-bot: scheduled cardinality scan: next run in 24h. current estimate: redwood_inference_requests_total ~ 650 unique label combinations in prod :chart_with_upwards_trend:

olivia: next steps — aj to open a PR with the proposed labels and sanitization functions, marie to update dashboard templates and example panels, suresh to run a quick cardinality runbook on dev cluster. target: merge in 3 business days. @eng-sre please add an alert if unique_label_count > 2000 for any metric

eng-sre: noted, will add alert and a playbook entry for label explosion. one ask: include a migration note for historical dashboards that assume routing_policy naming

olivia: thanks all. keeping this thread as the single source for the final label list. will post PR link here when opened :thumbsup:
